linkly v0.3.0 — the production-readiness release

linkly v0.3.0

The production-readiness release: everything the 2026-08-05 probe blocked,
measured again on 2026-08-07 as resolved.

Language (RFC-0015, RFC-0016):

  • Guard comparisons against entity fields (product.stock >= order.quantity)
  • Binary arithmetic, ==/!=, and-composition, input. payload guards
  • set to assignment with observable effects
  • DateTime comparison/arithmetic via epoch-ms codec; Duration units ms/s/m/h/d
  • Time-window policies (requestedAt - createdAt <= 30d)
  • event on schedule daily at HH:MM UTC (declared, UNENFORCED; executor is #26)

Runtime and observability (RFC-0014, issues #43-#46, #48):

  • Masking enforced on every output channel; differential scans the leak channel
  • Guard skips observable: skipped[] records, guard-skipped-steps diagnostic, --strict rc=2
  • Refinement facets enforced at runtime in both modes
  • Silent-evaporation paths surfaced: chained guards, unknown verbs, undeclared
    event references, --field typos
  • Spec runner: independent cases, field-merge given, failure reasons

Docs (RFC-0017, issue #50): naming/grammar rules, guarded.lnpl restored,
--workflow candidate listing, KB security routing, CLI surface doc.

Numbers: suite 1,204 -> 1,513; frictions 46 -> 33 resolved / 7 partial / 6 remaining;
verdict No-Go -> conditional Go (batch/aggregation still Block).
Known issues: #51 (until entry-true mode B divergence), #25, #26.
Reports: qa/REPORT.md (probe), qa/rerun/REPORT.md (re-measurement).

v0.2.0 — the lnpl MLIR dialect, and all nine agent roles

Everything v0.1.0 named as unfinished is now done: the custom lnpl MLIR dialect,
the last agent role, and both of that tag's known limitations.

264 → 386 tests. 5 merged PRs, 50 files, +7573/−250.

What works

Everything in v0.1.0, plus:

  • RFC-0004 stage S4 — the custom lnpl MLIR dialect (#6). Mode B no longer
    jumps from Semantic IR straight to standard dialects. It emits an lnpl module,
    build() verifies it, and the standard-dialect lowering reads the same op stream.
    Every op carries the originating node id on both paths RFC-0004 requires — the
    lnpl.node_id attribute and a loc(...) — and the dialect's verifier enforces
    the attribute's presence and type.

    It needs no C++ TableGen build. v0.1.0 said it did; that was wrong. The
    dialect is defined declaratively in mlir/lnpl.irdl.mlir and loaded into stock
    mlir-opt with --irdl-file. The prerequisite is still just brew install llvm.

  • All nine agent roles (#14). RefactoringAgent performs the one restructuring
    the KB grounds — patterns-repository-call's "한 step에 한 저장소 접근" — and
    declines anything else. A test asserts protocol.ROLES equals the implemented
    class set.

    Getting there needed RFC-0010, which states for the first time how a role
    attaches a node it authored to a node it may not author, and what happens to a
    reference that moves rather than disappearing. A proposal now declares its
    structural intent and the Reviewer validates the merged document's invariants
    instead of diffing surfaces. No new protocol method — the set stays at 8.

  • until obeys its condition in mode B (#5). At this tag's predecessor, mode B
    statically unrolled to the round cap and behaved as though the condition never
    became true; until counter >= 10 with counter = 10 ran 16 iterations against
    mode A's 0. Both modes now agree at 0, 9, 10 and 100.

  • G8's condition-field list has one source (#4). It was derived independently in
    three places, so a workflow with a different number of condition fields could
    silently take the wrong guard branch and exit 0.

  • The deliberate-mismatch suite actually detects (#10). Three of its five cases
    were passing against a standing divergence their own patch never caused. All five
    now assert an equivalent baseline first and pin the specific failure class.

RFCs

Eleven documents; eight Accepted. New since v0.1.0:

RFC
0008 Guard Conditions Condition ::= Presence | Comparison. Removes the 1–4-token phrase form no evaluator implemented. Updates 0002 §Full grammar, 0003 §Guard
0009 Guard Condition OQ Retires RFC-0002's open question ② now that the grammar is settled. Updates 0002 §Open Questions
0010 Proposal Intent Attachment and move semantics for ir.propose. Updates 0006 §Agent Roles & IR Access, §Methods/ir.propose

RFC-0004's S4 deviation note is retired, and its Open Question ② (the dialect's op
list and location notation) is resolved.

Known limitations

  • Mode B does not enforce RFC-0003's cache-TTL contract
    (#9). Mode A refuses a
    CacheAccess set with no budget; mode B prints and returns 0. A workflow without
    a performance / cache clause therefore makes the two modes disagree — and the
    differential check correctly reports it. Pinned by a test that goes red when mode
    B learns to enforce it.
  • S5's lowering consumes an in-memory op stream, not the re-parsed lnpl module
    (#7). The module is kept
    load-bearing by the build failing when its verifier rejects it, and by a test that
    the two renderings describe the same workflow. Making the lowering a real MLIR
    pass — and giving the dialect regions, without which it cannot represent
    concurrency at all — is the follow-up.
  • RFC-0004's document invariants V1 and V5 are not enforced
    (#15). V5 (kind별 children 허용) is checked only where RFC-0010 attaches; nothing checks it document-wide,
    and the schema types children as an unrestricted id array.
  • Mode A and mode B take a Presence guard's condition from different inputs
    (#12). Mode A reads the
    payload; mode B takes a separate skip flag. A caller must keep them consistent
    by hand, and a mismatch looks like a backend divergence.
  • RFC-0007 is Status: Draft while being the effective process that two
    Accepted RFCs build on (#11).
  • ir.propose's rationale and kb_pins are declared required and never read
    (#13).
  • RFC-0001's prose says 19 node kinds; its tables list 20
    (#17). The tables and the
    implementation agree; the count was not updated when Guard was added.

One mutation in impl/tests/mutation_check.py — drop the retry attempt cap —
hangs rather than failing, because removing the cap produces an infinite loop the
harness can only time out on. Pre-existing, and the reason its verdict reads FAIL
while 72 of 73 are caught.

Not in this release

SecurityAuditor and PerformanceAnalyzer still report attachment_required
rather than using RFC-0010's attachment path
(#16). The capability is live for
every role; only those two agents' own code declines.

See the roadmap.

Note on the split transform

RefactoringAgent's split preserves the order of effects but not retry
grouping — the KB's reason for one access per step is that a step is the unit of
retry and span, so a moved access stops being retried with the one it left
(measured: 3 executions become 1). That is the prescription's purpose, but RFC-0006
calls this role meaning-preserving and only half of that holds. RFC-0010 §Examples
records it.

v0.1.0 — parser, semantic IR, and native compilation

First tagged release. Phases 1–2 of the roadmap are complete: .lnpl parses, lowers to a semantic
IR, and runs both on the IR interpreter and as a native binary.

What works

  • Language + semantic IR — .lnpl source parses and lowers to the IR described in RFC-0001.
  • Mode A — IR interpreter. The reference implementation executes the golden scenario end to end.
  • Mode B — native compilation. The same IR compiles through MLIR to a native binary.
  • Differential verification. A differential check compares modes A and B on the four observable
    classes RFC-0004 names — execution order, policy outcome, observability signals, masking — and is
    proven able to go red by a deliberate-mismatch case. It reports EQUIVALENT on the golden
    scenario    ; see Known limitations for where the two modes do diverge.
  • Guard conditions. when comparison guards are evaluated at runtime in both modes, with
    condition-field values passed to the binary as arguments (RFC-0008 G8).
  • OpenAPI generation. The spec is generated from the IR rather than hand-maintained — and so is
    the golden scenario itself.
  • 264 tests passing.

RFCs

Eight RFCs, all Accepted:

RFC Title
0000 RFC process
0001 Semantic IR
0002 Syntax
0003 Runtime
0004 Compiler
0005 Knowledge base
0006 Agent protocol
0007 RFC process v2
0008 Guard conditions

RFC bodies are written in Korean; identifiers, keywords, and schema fields are English.

Known limitations

  • until is not evaluated at runtime in mode B. It is statically unrolled to
    _UNTIL_ROUND_CAP (16), so once the condition holds the two modes diverge: with
    until counter >= 10, mode A runs 0 iterations at counter = 10 while mode B still runs 16. The
    differential check's EQUIVALENT result therefore covers the golden scenario's range, not every
    payload. Fixed after this tag in #5; the
    remaining part of issue #3 is the guard
    condition grammar, which still admits phrases no evaluator implements.
  • RFC-0008 G8's condition-field plumbing is only correct for two condition fields at this tag.
    lnpl_run's parameters were derived independently in three places, so a workflow with a different
    number of condition fields, or a payload carrying an unrelated integer, could silently take the
    wrong guard branch with exit code 0. The CLI's build --run never forwarded values at all.
    Fixed after this tag in #4; if you are evaluating
    guard conditions, build from main rather than from v0.1.0.

Not in this release

Phase 3 — a custom lnpl MLIR dialect — is not started. It needs C++ TableGen; tracked in
issue #1.

See the roadmap for what comes next.

linkly v0.3.0 — 生产就绪版本

链接 v0.3.0

生产就绪版本：2026-08-05 探测器阻止的所有内容均已于 2026-08-07 再次测量并已解决。

语言（RFC-0015、RFC-0016）：

  • 保护与实体字段的比较（product.stock >= order.quantity）
  • 二进制算术，==/!=，与组合，输入。 有效载荷防护装置
  • 设置为具有可观察效果的分配
  • 通过 epoch-ms 编解码器进行日期时间比较/算术；持续时间单位 ms/s/m/h/d
  • 时间窗口策略（requestedAt -createdAt <= 30d）
  • 每天在 HH:MM UTC 时间按计划进行活动（已声明，未执行；执行者为 #26）

运行时和可观察性（RFC-0014，问题#43-#46，#48）：

  • 每个输出通道强制屏蔽；差分扫描泄漏通道
  • Guard 跳过可观察的：skipped[] 记录、guard-skipped-steps 诊断、--strict rc=2
  • 在两种模式下运行时强制执行细化方面
  • 无声的蒸发路径浮出水面：连锁守卫、未知动词、未声明的事件引用、--field 拼写错误
  • Spec runner：独立案例、给出的字段合并、失败原因

文档（RFC-0017，问题 #50）：命名/语法规则、guarded.lnpl 恢复、--workflow 候选列表、KB 安全路由、CLI 表面文档。

数量：套房 1,204 -> 1,513；摩擦 46 -> 33 已解决/7 部分/6 剩余；判决 No-Go -> 有条件 Go（批量/聚合仍为 Block）。 已知问题：#51（直到进入真模式 B 发散）、#25、#26。 报告：qa/REPORT.md（探测）、qa/rerun/REPORT.md（重新测量）。

v0.2.0 — lnpl MLIR 方言，以及所有九个代理角色

所有 v0.1.0 命名为未完成的内容现已完成：自定义 lnpl MLIR 方言、最后一个代理角色以及该标签的两个已知限制。

264 → 386 次测试。 5 个合并的 PR，50 个文件，+7573/−250。

什么有效

v0.1.0 中的所有内容，加上：

  • RFC-0004 阶段 S4 — 自定义 lnpl MLIR 方言 (#6)。 模式 B 不再从语义 IR 直接跳转到标准方言。 它发出一个 lnpl 模块，build() 验证它，标准方言降低读取相同的操作流。 每个操作都在 RFC-0004 要求的两条路径上携带原始节点 id — lnpl.node_id 属性和 loc(...) — 并且方言的验证器强制属性的存在和类型。 它不需要 C++ TableGen 构建。 v0.1.0 说是的；那是错误的。 该方言在 mlir/lnpl.irdl.mlir 中以声明方式定义，并使用 --irdl-file 加载到库存 mlir-opt 中。 前提条件仍然只是brew install llvm。
  • 所有九个特工角色（#14）。 RefactoringAgent 执行对 KB 基础的重构 — 模式存储库调用的“一次访问一个存储库” — 并拒绝任何其他操作。 测试断言 protocol.ROLES 等于已实现的类集。 实现这一目标需要 RFC-0010，它首次说明角色如何将其创作的节点附加到其可能未创作的节点，以及移动而不是消失的引用会发生什么情况。 提案现在声明其结构意图，审阅者验证合并文档的不变量而不是差异表面。 没有新的协议方法——集合保持在 8。
  • 直到遵守模式 B 中的条件（#5）。 在这个标签的前身中，模式 B 静态地展开到圆帽，并且表现得好像条件从未成为现实；直到 counter >= 10 并且 counter = 10 针对模式 A 的 0 运行 16 次迭代。 两种模式现在都一致为 0、9、10 和 100。
  • G8 的条件字段列表只有一个来源（#4）。 它是在三个地方独立导出的，因此具有不同数量条件字段的工作流可能会默默地采用错误的保护分支并退出 0。
  • 故意不匹配套件实际上可以检测到（#10）。 其五个案例中的三个都通过了他们自己的补丁从未造成的长期分歧。 所有五个现在首先断言等效基线并固定特定的故障类别。

RFCs

十一份文件；八 已接受。 v0.1.0 以来的新增内容：

RFC
0008 守卫条件 条件 ::= 存在 |比较。 删除了未实现评估器的 1-4 个标记短语。 更新 0002 §完整语法，0003 §Guard
0009 警卫条件 OQ 既然语法已经解决，就废弃 RFC-0002 的开放问题 ②。 更新 0002 §未决问题
0010 求婚意向 ir.propose 的附件和移动语义。 更新 0006 §代理角色和 IR 访问，§Methods/ir.propose

RFC-0004 的 S4 偏差注释已停用，其开放问题 ②（方言的操作列表和位置符号）已解决。

已知的限制

  • 模式 B 不强制执行 RFC-0003 的缓存 TTL 协定 (#9)。 模式A拒绝没有预算的CacheAccess集；模式 B 打印并返回 0。 因此，没有性能/缓存子句的工作流程会使两种模式不一致，并且差异检查会正确报告这一点。 由测试固定，当模式 B 学会强制执行它时，该测试会变成红色。
  • S5 的降低消耗内存中的操作流，而不是重新解析的 lnpl 模块（#7）。 当验证者拒绝构建时，该模块会因构建失败而保持负载，并通过测试两个渲染描述相同的工作流程。 后续工作是降低真正的 MLIR 通行证，并提供方言区域，没有方言区域就根本无法表示并发性。
  • RFC-0004 的文档不变量 V1 和 V5 未强制执行 (#15)。 V5（kind별 Children 허용）仅在附加 RFC-0010 的地方进行检查；没有任何东西在文档范围内检查它，并且模式将子项类型作为不受限制的 id 数组。
  • 模式 A 和模式 B 从不同的输入获取存在警卫的条件 (#12)。 模式A读取有效负载；模式 B 采用单独的跳过标志。 调用者必须手动保持它们一致，不匹配看起来就像后端分歧。
  • RFC-0007 状态：草案，同时是两个已接受的 RFC 构建的有效流程 (#11)。
  • ir.propose 的基本原理和 kb_pins 被声明为必需且从未阅读（#13）。
  • RFC-0001的散文说有19种节点；它的表列出了 20 个（#17）。 表格和实施一致；添加 Guard 时计数未更新。

impl/tests/mutation_check.py 中的一个突变 — 删除重试尝试上限 — 会挂起而不是失败，因为删除上限会产生无限循环，安全带只能超时。 已经存在，这也是其判决为“失败”而 73 人中有 72 人被捕的原因。

不在本版本中

SecurityAuditor 和 PerformanceAnalyzer 仍然报告 Attachment_required，而不是使用 RFC-0010 的附件路径 (#16)。 该功能适用​​于每个角色；只有这两个代理自己的代码会被拒绝。

请参阅路线图。

关于分割变换的注意事项

RefactoringAgent 的拆分保留了效果的顺序，但不保留重试分组 - 知识库每步进行一次访问的原因是步骤是重试和跨度的单位，因此移动的访问将停止与剩余的访问一起重试（测量：3 次执行变为 1）。 这就是处方的目的，但 RFC-0006 称这种作用为意义保留，而这种说法只成立了一半。 RFC-0010 §示例记录了它。

v0.1.0 — 解析器、语义 IR 和本机编译

第一个标记发布。 路线图的第 1-2 阶段已完成：.lnpl 解析、降低为语义 IR，并在 IR 解释器上运行并作为本机二进制文件运行。

什么有效

  • 语言 + 语义 IR — .lnpl 源解析并降低为 RFC-0001 中描述的 IR。
  • 模式 A — 红外解释器。 参考实现端到端地执行黄金场景。
  • 模式 B——本机编译。 相同的 IR 通过 MLIR 编译为本机二进制文件。
  • 差异验证。 差异检查比较四个可观察类 RFC-0004 名称（执行顺序、策略结果、可观察性信号、屏蔽）上的模式 A 和 B，并被证明能够因故意不匹配的情况而变红。 它报告黄金场景的等效性；请参阅已知限制，了解两种模式的不同之处。
  • 守卫条件。 当比较防护在两种模式下在运行时评估时，条件字段值作为参数传递给二进制文件（RFC-0008 G8）。
  • OpenAPI 生成。 该规范是由 IR 生成的，而不是手动维护的 - 黄金场景本身也是如此。
  • 264 项测试通过。

RFCs

已知的限制

  • 在模式 B 中，until 不会在运行时求值。 它静态展开到 _UNTIL_ROUND_CAP (16)，因此一旦条件成立，两种模式就会发散：直到 counter >= 10，模式 A 在 counter = 10 时运行 0 次迭代，而模式 B 仍运行 16。 因此，差异检查的等效结果涵盖了黄金场景的范围，而不是每个有效负载。 在 #5 中此标签后修复；问题 #3 的剩余部分是保护条件语法，它仍然接受评估器没有实现的短语。
  • RFC-0008 G8 的条件字段管道仅适用于此标记处的两个条件字段。 lnpl_run 的参数是在三个地方独立导出的，因此具有不同数量条件字段的工作流或携带不相关整数的有效负载可能会默默地采用退出代码为 0 的错误保护分支。 CLI 的 build --run 根本不转发值。 在 #4 中此标签后修复；如果您正在评估保护条件，请从 main 而不是从 v0.1.0 构建。
